_comment: Core simulation timing and world defaults. Every value here is tunable without touching engine code (spec section 45).

tick._comment: Fixed timestep. The simulation NEVER integrates with a frame delta; time scaling changes how many fixed ticks run per rendered frame, not the size of a tick.
tick._maxStepsPerFrameComment: Upper bound on catch-up work in one frame. When 10x speed cannot keep up, the sim runs in slow motion instead of spiralling.

replay._comment: Snapshot cadence for rewind. A snapshot every N ticks bounds how far the engine must re-simulate to reach an arbitrary point.

lod._comment: Stage 9 level of detail. These throttle AI and damage-control update RATES only. Ballistics, trajectory tracing and penetration are never simplified, because spec section 39 requires combat outcomes to stay consistent regardless of camera distance.
